originalLicenseNote: Engine source under GPL-3.0; embeds the network nnue.bin.zst from the engine's own repository, trained with bullet on data generated by the Leela Chess Zero project, which is available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
blurb: Cinder 0.6.1 is the August 2026 release of Bruno Dutra's GPL Rust UCI chess engine, written from scratch on portable SIMD. It pairs a vectorized board with legal move generation, fractional singular extensions with multi-cut and negative extensions, ProbCut, razoring, reverse futility, null-move, late-move and SEE pruning, and pawn, piece, minor, major and continuation correction histories with an embedded NNUE of king-bucketed piece-square and threat inputs, a 1024-wide accumulator and float hidden layers in 8 phase buckets. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the Rust poll helper.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build on the Rust poll helper, with its broadcast executor running the search on the UCI thread and Threads fixed to 1; built with the dated nightly Rust its unstable features need; the engine's portable SIMD compiled to 128-bit WebAssembly SIMD, with moves and node counts over its 50 bench positions equal to the native x86-64-v2 build's (its AVX2 path sums a float layer in another order); a mask wider than 16 lanes takes its bitmask from 16-lane groups, which the toolchain's WebAssembly SIMD returns in reverse order otherwise; hash and thread memory from the allocator, not memory maps; no Syzygy tablebases; Hash capped at 1024 MB.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Principal variation search with iterative deepening and aspiration windows.

features.label: Mate Distance Pruning
features.implementation: Alpha and beta bounded by the mate distance from the root.

features.label: Reverse Futility Pruning
features.implementation: Static-eval margin pruning, adjusted for improving positions.

features.label: Razoring
features.implementation: Quiescence verification at low depth when the eval is far below alpha.

features.label: ProbCut
features.implementation: Reduced search against a raised beta, with a margin for improving positions.

features.label: Internal Iterative Reductions
features.implementation: Reductions on cut and all nodes without a hash move.

features.label: Singular Extensions
features.implementation: Fractional extensions that grow with the margin by which the hash move stands out, with multi-cut and negative extensions.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Logarithmic reductions adjusted by history, node type, checks and improvement.

features.label: Late-Move & SEE Pruning
features.implementation: Late-move, futility and SEE pruning in the moves loop.

features.label: Quiescence Search
features.implementation: Captures with futility and SEE pruning in leaf nodes.

features.label: Histories & Correction
features.implementation: Quiet and continuation histories with killers, plus pawn, piece, minor, major and continuation correction histories.

features.label: Transposition Table
features.implementation: Shared hash table beside a value table for static evals, split from one Hash setting.

features.label: NNUE
features.implementation: Embedded perspective net: king-bucketed piece-square and threat inputs, a 1024-wide accumulator, an integer layer then float layers with squared activations, in 8 phase buckets.
